_about: Years whose maps were reviewed against scientific sources. 'years': maps drawn only from dated finds — empty land is hatched as 'No data'. 'probability': maps where an area is coloured if the species' presence is more likely than 50 % — no hatching, empty land = 'probability below 50 %'. 'coastNotes': key (or list of keys, one line each) of a note shown under the year (translations/ui); on a map with an ancient coastline it is shown after the sea level. 'draftNotes': key of the 'Draft: reviewed …' line under the year of a map still being reviewed part by part (map 5000 on, item 5000bc-1); a new key with every applied part of the world, removed when the whole map is reviewed. 'regions': for a map reviewed only in part, the outline (corrections/regions/<shape>.geojson) of the reviewed parts — only there empty land is hatched — and the key of a note under the year. See corrections/README.md. 'noSource': years without a source map (map 6000*) — built from our zones only, starting from empty land.
